Apply with your résumé and an accessible portfolio link.

Short-form and long-form videos.

Product videos using screenshots and screen recordings.
Videos created from property photographs and raw field footage.
Content series developed from articles and other long-form material.
Carousels, graphics, thumbnails and supporting visual content.
Platform-specific versions for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn and X.

Turn approved ideas and briefs into finished content.
Develop hooks, scripts and simple storyboards.
Generate and edit AI video, images, avatars and voiceovers.

Excellent written and spoken English.

jobs.description:
About HOLY

HOLY is the soft drink revolution: With our product lines Energy®, Iced Tea®, Hydration®, Milkshake®, and our newest innovation, the HOLY Syrup Bottle®, you get amazing taste across 50+ flavors while maintaining a good conscience—for your body & the environment.
Over 2M loyal customers: Started in a shared apartment by three best friends, we have scaled to Europe's fastest-growing consumer brand—and our cult-like community, the HOLY Squad, loves it: 4.6 stars on reviews.io speak for themselves.
From D2C to Global Omnichannel: In less than four years, we've profitably scaled HOLY to more than €200M D2C revenue in DACH, FR, UK, and PL. Now scaling our retail business, we're on an exciting transition to becoming a true omnichannel rocketship.
We are still just getting started: Backed by the world's best consumer investors, we aim to revolutionize the soft drink industry and build a generational love brand: tastier, healthier & more sustainable. Our team of 200+ people aims high (Coca-Cola, we're coming for you!).

About The Position

Paid social is one of HOLY’s most important growth channels, helping us reach new audiences and build the most loved soft drink brand.

We’re looking for a Sr. Creative Strategist – Paid Social
to own the creative strategy behind our evergreen testing engine and campaign calendar across HOLY’s four markets.

Sitting at the intersection of brand and paid social, you’ll turn customer insights, performance learnings, and platform trends into unmistakably HOLY concepts, briefs, and creative tests that unlock new audiences and help scale HOLY’s paid social engine beyond €3m in monthly spend. You will report to Bella, our Head of Brand, and work closely with our Paid Social team.

Responsibilities:

Own global paid social creative strategy: Own the creative strategy across HOLY’s evergreen testing engine and campaign calendar across all four core markets, primarily on Meta. Set a global creative direction that can be adapted locally, with particular focus on DACH as HOLY’s core market, while building an approach that can scale as the business expands.
Deliver high-quality briefs at scale: Produce a consistent baseline of at least 10 execution-ready creative briefs per week once fully ramped, aligned with the Paid Social testing roadmap and the Creative Studio’s production capacity. Prioritize quality, clarity, and learning value, ensuring each brief can move efficiently from hypothesis to production and testing.
Turn insights into a creative testing roadmap: Translate customer insights, performance learnings, market and competitor research, and platform trends into clear creative hypotheses, benefit-led concepts, hooks, and visual ideas. Decide what to test, why, and when, balancing new concepts with iterations of winning ideas and setting priorities across formats, channels, and markets in collaboration with the Paid Social team.
Write clear creative briefs: Establish what a high-quality paid social brief looks like and ensure the executional team has the strategic context needed to produce strong work. Briefs should clearly define the funnel stage, category or product focus, messaging angle, target audience, core hypothesis, market relevance, execution ideas, and supporting references.
Lead creative brainstorming and debriefs: Own the monthly creative brainstorming and debrief sessions with channel/market owners, media buyers, and the Creative Studio. Turn collective ideas and performance learnings into clear creative priorities and strong briefs for the next testing cycle.
Enable creative excellence through strategic briefing: Give designers, copywriters, content creators, and video editors the context they need to produce work that is unmistakably HOLY and built for paid social. Stay close to the work throughout production to clarify the brief and check strategic alignment, while leaving discipline-specific craft decisions to the relevant team leads.
Partner with the Paid Social team: Work closely with Media Buyers and the wider Paid Social team to understand creative performance, channel strategy, scale requirements, and budget priorities. Use these inputs to identify new creative opportunities, improve underperforming concepts, and inform future iterations.

About You

Conceptual and creative thinking: Strong ability to develop distinctive, commercially relevant concepts and identify what makes an idea, hook, script, or execution genuinely strong.
Performance mindset: Understands the paid social funnel and how creative contributes at each stage. Comfortable working with hard metrics such as spend, CAC, and CVR, as well as creative signals such as hook rate and watch time, using these inputs to develop stronger concepts, hooks, angles and visual ideas.
Copywriting and scripting: Strong direct-response copywriting background, with the ability to write and improve hooks, headlines, scripts, calls to action, and messaging frameworks. Comfortable working hands-on with copywriters and the wider executional team to strengthen concepts and improve conversion.
Make insights usable: Able to distill complex customer psychology, market context, competitor activity, and performance learnings into clear, accessible inputs for the wider creative team. Builds practical insight libraries, frameworks, or other lightweight systems that make learnings easy to understand, reuse, and apply in future concept development.
Creative direction and feedback: Communicates a clear creative point of view in briefs and assesses final outputs against them, giving focused feedback on strategic alignment, concept strength, and performance potential while leaving craft decisions to the relevant team leads.
Global and local mindset: Proven experience developing paid social creative for the DACH market, combined with a global mindset suited to building scalable evergreen creative systems. Able to develop concepts with cross-market potential and know when to involve local teams to adapt language, formats, cultural references, or insights. Experience across France, the UK, or Poland is a strong plus.
Ownership and collaboration: Proactive, structured, and comfortable leading brainstorming and debrief sessions, aligning different cross-functional stakeholders, making decisions, and moving from insight to execution in a fast-moving environment.
Communication: Fluent in English; German is a plus.

Our Offering

In today's job market, A-players have many options to choose from. As part of our offer, we prioritize providing a productive working environment and opportunities for growth. In addition to competitive compensation, including company shares, you can expect:

A successful and growing company: Join a company that has been growing profitably and quickly for the last 36+ months and has raised a Series B, while many other e-commerce companies are struggling.
Huge impact: Enjoy huge impact to shape HOLY's internationalization in a top market.
Awesome team: Join an awesome team of colleagues who are ambitious, funny, down-to-earth, and authentic. Get to know us and see for yourself!
Top product: Marketing is important, but a good product is essential. Our differentiated soft drinks have won over customers. Check out our reviews.io reviews or contact us for free samples.
Startup culture: Join a startup culture that values flat hierarchies, fast pace, and personal development. With us, you can make a real impact.
Perfect setup: Enjoy a perfect setup that includes all the requirements of a modern employer, such as a central office in Berlin Prenzlauer Berg, flexible working hours, and much more.
Competitive comp. + equity: Join us at a pivotal stage of hypergrowth. We offer a strong salary and meaningful equity — giving you the chance to share in our current success and benefit from the massive upside as we scale.
How we support your growth: flexible hours, 28 vacation days, 30 work-from-abroad days, €1,500 learning budget, Urban Sports Club membership, public transport subsidy, and biannual 360° feedback tied to your compensation.

Find out more about HOLY and our team on our careers page.

The Process

As we are experiencing rapid growth and have ambitious plans, the optimal start date for the position is today. Nonetheless, we are prepared to patiently await the arrival of the ideal candidate, recognizing that quality ultimately yields the best results.

Getting to know you: We will have a 30-minute screening interview where we will talk to you more about HOLY and the position to see if our expectations match.
Hiring Manager interview with Bella: We will dive a bit deeper into your experience and details of the role.
Case study & on-site interview: As soon as you have successfully completed the first interviews, you will receive a case study. In a second meeting at our office, the team will discuss your case study with you and answer questions about our workspace, the HOLY Temple.
Reference calls: At this stage, we’d like to connect with 1–2 former colleagues or managers who have worked closely with you. These conversations help us better understand your working style and strengths from those who know you professionally.
Interview with Matze: As a strong cultural fit is important to us, you will have a final meeting with Matze, one of our HOLY Founders. This gives both you and us the opportunity for a final check.
Job offer and decision: If everything goes well, you will receive an offer, and we are ready to embark on this journey together with you!

Typically, this process should take around 2-3 weeks.

About Black Forest Labs

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.

Why This Role

Our models need someone who knows them inside out — not just what they can do today, but what nobody has tried yet. You'll create the work that makes people realize what's possible with generative media: original pieces, experiments, and creative assets that set the standard for what FLUX can do, and show it to the world.

What You'll Work On

Build end-to-end production workflows that push FLUX to its limits — experiments, visual explorations, and pieces tailored to brand, agency, and entertainment use cases that show what's possible before anyone else figures it out.
Test and explore models, endpoints, and features that are still in development — you're the one figuring out what they can actually do, and turning that into new insights for image, video generation and more
Create and maintain a library of demo boards, templates, and pipelines that make the product's value obvious in live pitches. Partner with Sales and FDEs on discovery and demo prep, and document what works so it scales across the team.
Support customer enablement - help define what's feasible for custom projects, fine-tuning, and creative workflows.
Work with DevRel, Product, Marketing and Growth to turn experiments into shareable, reproducible examples and insights.

What We're Looking For

3+ years in creative technology, digital art, or experimental media.
You use generative AI for image and video every day, deeply and practically — enough to know intuitively where it breaks down and where it delivers.
A portfolio that demonstrates strong taste, solid craft, and versatility across mediums and tools.
Background in brand, agency, or film/VFX work — you understand the real process behind shipping professional creative.
You move easily through the FLUX ecosystem and the tools around it, from ComfyUI to AI Toolkit and beyond.
Deep understanding of generative AI, agents, and diffusion models.
Working knowledge of Python for scripting and rapid prototyping.

.

This position sits in our Marketing & Technology service, working with our UK teams from Hungary. We are looking for an AI Designer & Creative Technologist to join our creative team. The role has two halves: delivering AI-led creative work on live client projects, and building the tools and workflows that make the wider agency faster at it. On the delivery side, you will take briefs from early thinking through to finished, client-ready work using generative image, video and audio tools alongside the Adobe suite, working with designers, motion designers, art directors and producers to make AI output on brand, consistent, and following legal specifications. Sports & cultural benefits to support your wellbeing and work-life balance.
Dog-friendly office

The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.
Global annual DEPT® Cares Month in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.

About HOLY

HOLY is the soft drink revolution: With our product lines Energy®, Iced Tea®, Hydration®, Milkshake®, and our newest innovation, the HOLY Syrup Bottle®, you get amazing taste across 50+ flavors while maintaining a good conscience—for your body & the environment.

We are still just getting started: Backed by the world's best consumer investors, we aim to revolutionize the soft drink industry and build a generational love brand: tastier, healthier & more sustainable. Our team of 200+ people aims high (Coca-Cola, we're coming for you!).

About The Position

Paid social is one of HOLY’s most important growth channels, helping us reach new audiences and build the most loved soft drink brand.

We’re looking for a Sr. Creative Strategist – Paid Social
to own the creative strategy behind our evergreen testing engine and campaign calendar across HOLY’s four markets.

Sitting at the intersection of brand and paid social, you’ll turn customer insights, performance learnings, and platform trends into unmistakably HOLY concepts, briefs, and creative tests that unlock new audiences and help scale HOLY’s paid social engine beyond €3m in monthly spend. You will report to Bella, our Head of Brand, and work closely with our Paid Social team.

Responsibilities:

Own global paid social creative strategy: Own the creative strategy across HOLY’s evergreen testing engine and campaign calendar across all four core markets, primarily on Meta. Set a global creative direction that can be adapted locally, with particular focus on DACH as HOLY’s core market, while building an approach that can scale as the business expands.
Deliver high-quality briefs at scale: Produce a consistent baseline of at least 10 execution-ready creative briefs per week once fully ramped, aligned with the Paid Social testing roadmap and the Creative Studio’s production capacity. Prioritize quality, clarity, and learning value, ensuring each brief can move efficiently from hypothesis to production and testing.
Turn insights into a creative testing roadmap: Translate customer insights, performance learnings, market and competitor research, and platform trends into clear creative hypotheses, benefit-led concepts, hooks, and visual ideas. Decide what to test, why, and when, balancing new concepts with iterations of winning ideas and setting priorities across formats, channels, and markets in collaboration with the Paid Social team.
Write clear creative briefs: Establish what a high-quality paid social brief looks like and ensure the executional team has the strategic context needed to produce strong work. Briefs should clearly define the funnel stage, category or product focus, messaging angle, target audience, core hypothesis, market relevance, execution ideas, and supporting references.
Lead creative brainstorming and debriefs: Own the monthly creative brainstorming and debrief sessions with channel/market owners, media buyers, and the Creative Studio. Turn collective ideas and performance learnings into clear creative priorities and strong briefs for the next testing cycle.
Enable creative excellence through strategic briefing: Give designers, copywriters, content creators, and video editors the context they need to produce work that is unmistakably HOLY and built for paid social. Stay close to the work throughout production to clarify the brief and check strategic alignment, while leaving discipline-specific craft decisions to the relevant team leads.
Partner with the Paid Social team: Work closely with Media Buyers and the wider Paid Social team to understand creative performance, channel strategy, scale requirements, and budget priorities. Use these inputs to identify new creative opportunities, improve underperforming concepts, and inform future iterations.

About You

Conceptual and creative thinking: Strong ability to develop distinctive, commercially relevant concepts and identify what makes an idea, hook, script, or execution genuinely strong.
Performance mindset: Understands the paid social funnel and how creative contributes at each stage. Comfortable working with hard metrics such as spend, CAC, and CVR, as well as creative signals such as hook rate and watch time, using these inputs to develop stronger concepts, hooks, angles and visual ideas.
Copywriting and scripting: Strong direct-response copywriting background, with the ability to write and improve hooks, headlines, scripts, calls to action, and messaging frameworks. Comfortable working hands-on with copywriters and the wider executional team to strengthen concepts and improve conversion.
Make insights usable: Able to distill complex customer psychology, market context, competitor activity, and performance learnings into clear, accessible inputs for the wider creative team. Builds practical insight libraries, frameworks, or other lightweight systems that make learnings easy to understand, reuse, and apply in future concept development.
Creative direction and feedback: Communicates a clear creative point of view in briefs and assesses final outputs against them, giving focused feedback on strategic alignment, concept strength, and performance potential while leaving craft decisions to the relevant team leads.
Global and local mindset: Proven experience developing paid social creative for the DACH market, combined with a global mindset suited to building scalable evergreen creative systems. Able to develop concepts with cross-market potential and know when to involve local teams to adapt language, formats, cultural references, or insights. Experience across France, the UK, or Poland is a strong plus.
Ownership and collaboration: Proactive, structured, and comfortable leading brainstorming and debrief sessions, aligning different cross-functional stakeholders, making decisions, and moving from insight to execution in a fast-moving environment.
Communication: Fluent in English; German is a plus.

Our Offering

In today's job market, A-players have many options to choose from. As part of our offer, we prioritize providing a productive working environment and opportunities for growth. In addition to competitive compensation, including company shares, you can expect:

A successful and growing company: Join a company that has been growing profitably and quickly for the last 36+ months and has raised a Series B, while many other e-commerce companies are struggling.
Huge impact: Enjoy huge impact to shape HOLY's internationalization in a top market.
Awesome team: Join an awesome team of colleagues who are ambitious, funny, down-to-earth, and authentic. Get to know us and see for yourself!
Top product: Marketing is important, but a good product is essential. Our differentiated soft drinks have won over customers. Check out our reviews.io reviews or contact us for free samples.
Startup culture: Join a startup culture that values flat hierarchies, fast pace, and personal development. With us, you can make a real impact.
Perfect setup: Enjoy a perfect setup that includes all the requirements of a modern employer, such as a central office in Berlin Prenzlauer Berg, flexible working hours, and much more.
Competitive comp. + equity: Join us at a pivotal stage of hypergrowth. We offer a strong salary and meaningful equity — giving you the chance to share in our current success and benefit from the massive upside as we scale.
How we support your growth: flexible hours, 28 vacation days, 30 work-from-abroad days, €1,500 learning budget, Urban Sports Club membership, public transport subsidy, and biannual 360° feedback tied to your compensation.

Find out more about HOLY and our team on our careers page.

The Process

As we are experiencing rapid growth and have ambitious plans, the optimal start date for the position is today. Nonetheless, we are prepared to patiently await the arrival of the ideal candidate, recognizing that quality ultimately yields the best results.

Getting to know you: We will have a 30-minute screening interview where we will talk to you more about HOLY and the position to see if our expectations match.

Case study & on-site interview: As soon as you have successfully completed the first interviews, you will receive a case study. In a second meeting at our office, the team will discuss your case study with you and answer questions about our workspace, the HOLY Temple.

Interview with Matze: As a strong cultural fit is important to us, you will have a final meeting with Matze, one of our HOLY Founders. This gives both you and us the opportunity for a final check.
Job offer and decision: If everything goes well, you will receive an offer, and we are ready to embark on this journey together with you!

Typically, this process should take around 2-3 weeks.
